name: mcp-events
description: Polls MCP Events (events/list, events/poll) on an MCP server's HTTP endpoint and starts a turn when one fires

url.title: MCP endpoint
url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of the server whose events to poll

server.title: Server name
server.description: The server's name in /mcp, used to tell the model whose tools to use

events.title: Event names
events.description: Comma-separated event names to subscribe to; empty: every event the server lists with poll delivery

superseded.title: Superseded event names
superseded.description: Comma-separated event names that are dropped when the model has called one of the server's tools since the event

waitTools.title: Wait tools
waitTools.description: Comma-separated tool names the model is told not to call, because an event resumes it instead

stateTools.title: State tools
stateTools.description: Comma-separated tool names (without the server prefix) whose results show the server's state; a call to one of them means the model has seen everything up to then
